name: ctao_pmt
label: CTAO camera PMT, SII readout (Stage I: QE 0.40, ~400 MHz)
sources: Biteau 2026-10-08, 'Stellar intensity interferometry with the CTAO' (La Palma), Stage I / Stage II table (slides 15-16, T. Hassan): Stage I photodetector QE 0.40, inverse time resolution ~400 MHz, noise factor 1.15

Biteau & Luce 2024-09-13, 'Stellar Intensity Interferometry with NectarCAM on the MSTs-N', CTA-N table (slides 18, 23): PMT QE at 420 nm 39 %, excess noise factor 1.21, transit-time spread 1.5 ns; maximum electronic bandwidth 650 MHz (LST) / 600 MHz (MST); simulations at 500 MHz
notes: Analog PMT 'detector' for the photon-counting cross-check path and for per-station backends (iact.IACTBackend.per_station: alpha = pde(lambda)).
The 2024 table gives 0.39 and F = 1.21, the 2026 Stage I table 0.40 and 1.15; the 2026 values are used.
